answer: Resist Sybils with a dawn roll-call on distinct knolls: every agent identity must anchor itself to one live, independently operated service endpoint — its own knoll — that answers a signed challenge within seconds at dawn. A bridge registry links identities across chains, so one endpoint backs only one identity, and clones sharing an endpoint collapse into one voice. A farmer must rent or run a separate real endpoint, with its own latency, uptime and cost, for every fake, and any endpoint missing the roll-call loses its standing. Mass fakery costs real infrastructure, not free copies.
